informal_statement: Hilbert's axiom system KD is weaker than KDB, meaning any theorem provable in KD is also provable in KDB.
informal_proof: To prove that Hilbert's axiom system KD is weaker than KDB, we show that every theorem provable in KD is also provable in KDB. Assume for contradiction that there exists a theorem provable in KD that is not provable in KDB. This would imply that KD contains a theorem outside the scope of KDB, contradicting the definition ofKD being a subset of KDB. Therefore, all theorems provable in KD are also provable in KDB, establishing that KD is indeed weaker than KDB.
